A previous investigator probed this dimension and inferred the following rules. Your job is ADVERSARIAL: actively try to FALSIFY each rule by finding inputs where it predicts the wrong output. For every rule, design at least 2 new inputs (not already tested) that would expose the rule as wrong if it is wrong, run them, and compare prediction vs reality. DIGIT+ <anything-ignored>.   },

Sweep of "-<byte>80" and "+<byte>80" over bytes 1..255: only the 10 ASCII digits are accepted (244 aborts each).
